result.finding: Application uses 3 Spring profiles: default (application.properties for local/generic), docker (application-docker.properties activated via SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=docker in docker-compose.yml), and test (application-test.properties with H2 in-memory database for testing). No @Profile-annotated Java classes found.
evidence: src/main/resources/application-docker.properties: docker profile (Oracle DB at oracle-db:1521:XE, reduced logging)
src/test/resources/application-test.properties: test profile (H2 in-memory DB, create-drop DDL)
docker-compose.yml: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=docker activates docker profile for container deployment
No @Profile annotations found in Java source code
No Maven profiles section in pom.xml
values: Profile activation: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=docker via docker-compose env variable
